feeds.title: UK Recruiter Blog
feeds.description: UK Recruiter is an information source for the recruitment and staffing industry focussed on the UK. They run a series of learning and networking events for the UK Recruitment community. UK Recruiter is the leading dedicated news and networking platform for the UK recruitment sector.

feeds.title: Undercover Recruiter
feeds.description: Talent acquisition is the heart of Undercover Recruiter and our content is topically written for in-house/HR and agency/3rd party recruiters.Born in 2009, out of frustration with the lack of industry transparency and personality (in a sea of boring, safe corporate articles), Undercover Recruiter became the independent voice in recruitment by sticking to founder Jörgen Sundberg's mission: to uncover what goes on behind the scenes in recruitment - and investigate the future.

feeds.title: Onrec
feeds.description: Onrec is the accompanying website to Onrec Magazine which takes an in depth look into the Internet recruitment and the industry suppliers. It is a online recruitment magazine for HR Directors, Personnel Managers, Job Boards and Recruiters with information on the internet recruitment industry.

feeds.title: Handle Recruitment Blog
feeds.description: Handle Recruitment is one stop destination for recruitment in leading entertainment companies, social networks, global media brands, sports bodies, retailers and digital technology. Follow this blog to find information about career advice, recruitment news, hint, tips and more.

feeds.title: occy Blog
feeds.description: Smart Recruit Online support over 25,000 UK Recruiters with a unique blend of best in class recruitment technology, tools and processes to aid the delivery of a more efficient and effective direct hire recruitment process.

feeds.title: Blue Octopus
feeds.description: We're an award-winning recruitment company with a difference! Working to a flat fee model, we throw out the agency rulebook and deliver top candidates first. Looking for a job? We know how hard it can be to know where to start. We thought you may need a helping tentacle to kick-start your job search and find the right job for you. Get recruitment and career advice from experts within the industry.

feeds.title: Brand Recruitment
feeds.description: Brand Recruitment is the go-to marketing recruitment agency for one of the UK's most innovative and exciting regions.Keep up-to-date with Brand Recruitment's marketing recruitment blog which unveils our knowledge of the industry as experts in PR and marketing recruitment.

feeds.title: 100% IT Recruitment Blog
feeds.description: A comprehensive IT Recruitment Solution for Permanent and Contract requirements across the UK.

feeds.title: Key Skills Education
feeds.description: Key Skills Education is an education recruitment agency that places teachers and teaching assistants into schools and education centres across London on long term and permanent placements. Follow this blog to keep up to date with education news, interesting information for teachers and job opportunities across London and the Home Counties.

feeds.title: Hiring Hub Blog
feeds.description: Hiring Hub is an award-winning online recruitment marketplace based in, and covering the UK. It connects companies to a trusted network of independent, specialist recruitment agencies. Hiring Hub is a UK-based technology company devoted to making recruitment faster and easier for its users, and delivering world class customer service with a cheerful edge. We love what we do, and will always go the extra mile to support clients.

feeds.title: Attic Recruitment Blog
feeds.description: Attic is a leading boutique recruitment agency in London specialising in placing permanent and temporary candidates in leading PA and Secretarial positions across the capital. They offer a thorough, discreet and above all professional service to companies and individuals throughout London and specialise in character-matching and taking the time to understand our candidates and clients. They specialise in character-matching and taking the time to understand the business, the company and the people.

feeds.title: Energi People Blog
feeds.description: Energi People are experts in construction engineering recruitment and passionate about helping engineering people innovate, achieve competitive advantages, deliver projects above expectations, expand overseas and win new business. feeds.title: Talent Yard
feeds.description: London based boutique recruitment agency specialising in providing PA and Secretarial support on a permanent and temporary basis.

feeds.title: Kiwi Recruitment
feeds.description: Kiwi Recruitment is the fresh and friendly approach to recruitment in Chichester, Sussex and Hampshire. We make the extra effort to really get to know our candidates and clients properly to help find and match the perfect role.

feeds.title: Gotcha Recruitment Solutions Blog
